messages:
Maria Lopez: Hey team — thinking we do a short passoff + runbook sync at 20:00 PT tonight. 20–30m, focused agenda so oncall handoffs are tighter. :spiral_calendar:
Devin K: Works for me. Can we add a 5m quick review of the spike on pager volume (incident #342)?
Samir: I can join but might be 5min late. I'll share the night-ops notes beforehand.
Marta Chen: +1 for runbook checks. Also propose pairing a liaison with the duty engineer for the first 2 handoffs this week.
Elaine: I can be liaison Wed/Thu. We should confirm escalation attendance matrix in the meeting (who picks up sev1/2 after 22:00 PT).
Maria Lopez: Agenda draft:
  1) 2-min roll call / who's currently oncall
  2) 5-min quick status on open incidents (#342, #347)
  3) 8-min runbook walk-through for common pages (token quota, model OOM, routing fail)
  4) 7-min escalation liaison assignment + shadow pairing
  5) 3-min quick sync on oncall docs updates + actions
Devin K: Suggest adding a one-line fallback protocol for model routing failures (where we fallback to smaller instance pool). Saves time during triage.
Samir: I'll paste the night-ops snippets into the thread before the meeting.
Marta Chen: Zoom link? and can we invite the new hire shadow (Elaine said yes) `@jun`?
Maria Lopez: Zoom: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210
Maria Lopez: I invited Jun and added the calendar invite. Ping me if you need a different slot.
oncall-bot: Incident #342 updated — status: investigating; assigned: Samir; priority: P2
Elaine: Quick note — runbook section "eviction-retry" has an outdated command. I'll open a PR after the meeting.
Devin K: If no objections, I'll take liaison for tonight's handoff and shadow with Jun for the first pass.
Samir: Thanks — I'll hand over logs and the temp mitigation steps in the invite notes.
Maria Lopez: Great. Final: start 20:00 PT, aim to finish by 20:30. If anything blocks, drop updates here. :thumbsup:
Marta Chen: ack. See you then.
Jun (guest): Thanks all — looking forward to shadowing.
Maria Lopez: closing the loop: calendar invite created + agenda pinned. Meeting notes will be posted to #eng-oncall/post-meeting.
